family_assessments.assessment: Intended challenge: identify the effective trustee roster at the bank-meeting cut-off despite signed papers and a later administrative message. The blind review (family_a/review/blind-review.md) verified the release-versus-affirmative-hold switch: release effects simultaneous retirement and replacement; hold preserves the incumbent. The necessity review (family_a/review/necessity.md) verified joint instrument-and-disposition routes and rejected a proposed short route. The matched-source record (family_a/review/matched-sources.json) verifies that reorder alone preserves the key and ordinary context. Supported kinship, banking paperwork and administrative detail are incidental. Later-message and name-frequency cues favour the incumbent, while draft promotion favours the successor; one two-person office and explanatory wording limit generalisation. Retain as the cut-off control, not as evidence about missing release records.

result.portfolio_summary: Five independent Matter histories are formally admitted: A, B, C, D and F. Count each history once, not once per matched condition, reorder or review mask. Joint proof and same-edge attachment recur across all five. A and D both exercise documentary authority but distinguish effectiveness from scope; B, C and F exercise identity or reference resolution under different information conditions. B and C verify local withholding, and C verifies preservation of a substantial ordinary graph. A alone provides an admitted order-only comparison. These are documentary and reasoning checks, not observations of extractor performance or of the effect of file length. X and T are technically qualified and explicitly await human admission: X adds a matched incidental assertion in native correspondence, and T adds bounded inspection scope at an intermediate workload. N revision 3, E revision 3 and W revision 2 are newly technically qualified; the packet records no human admission for them. N addresses execution status; E and W address independent disagreement through different designs. The returned E0/E1 materials remain diagnostic only. No other retained attempt or earlier reserve is credited with admission, and the original AB and AD workflows did not reach a valid Source freeze. The ten-family planning target and the pre-giant goal of 19 independent development histories are distinct from the current count of five admissions. There are no paid extraction observations or sealed evaluation inputs. Rank the new reserve AX, AY, AZ: AX offers the most new coverage and a useful moderate inventory at the highest review cost; AY isolates whether a named provision depends on a separately documented family status at routine scale; AZ is a lower-cost natural-file check on the difference between a drafting definition and a factual kinship assertion. These are proposals, not commissions, admissions or substitutes for the separate intermediate and large workload commitments.

evidence_dependencies: Use two isolated complete-file reconstructions per branch and fresh excerpt readers to test exact passages for the appointment, qualifying act, attribution, receipt timing and grouping rule, as well as the branch-specific evidence for excluding the uncommenced appointments.

Test singletons and credible shorter routes, particularly a receipt acknowledgement that might itself establish all acceptance facts. Remove the grouping, acceptance and receipt facts separately, including dependent copies; separately mask the deferral and rederive what becomes unknown rather than treating silence as completed acceptance or as refusal.
Require every necessary passage in a verified sufficient subset on the same trustee edge. Audit graph-to-file and file-to-graph, and show that masking provider papers leaves both keys unchanged.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: Only the first candidate's trustee relationship changes. The strongest positive observation is the named acceptance and independently dated qualifying receipt read under the individual commencement rule. The strongest negative observation for joint commencement is the second candidate's express deferral read under the joint rule, despite the first receipt. Record the pending appointment in the companion register; do not emit a negative edge.
genres_and_provenance: Trustees' verified governing extract supplies the trust, power and continuing office; the executed appointment instrument is retained in the governance file and states the two appointments and commencement rule.

The first candidate's signed acceptance is retained as received. The receiving trustee's dated acknowledgement records receipt, drawing on the receiving record rather than merely repeating a date supplied by the candidate. The other candidate's native deferred response is kept for handover coordination.

The trustee minute commissions the practical handover; the adviser's native provider enquiry requests advance requirements; the provider's separately issued reply sets out what it needs; and the provider's dated holdings statement identifies the portfolio in scope. Each serves a handover task rather than recording the office outcome.
The dated adviser review brief sets the cut-off and distinguishes the office question from provider implementation.
design.intervention: Replace exactly one literal commencement-rule span in the executed appointment instrument: individual commencement on that candidate's qualifying receipt versus joint commencement when both qualifying receipts have occurred. Keep every other byte and Source order fixed.
invariants: The trust, candidates, continuing office, operative instrument status, acceptance contents, receipt and deferral facts, provider material and cut-off remain fixed.
The second candidate is not licensed as a current trustee in either branch. The continuing office and its independent proof survive both branches.
negative_controls: Execution, the advance provider requirements and inclusion in a handover plan are not evidence that either candidate has commenced office.
The independently established continuing office survives provider-paper masks and focal proof diagnostics.
design.scenario: At a dated handover review, the adviser has the issued appointment papers and the actual acceptance trail, as well as provider material needed for preparations. The threshold question is which appointment a qualifying receipt can commence, not whether receipt happened or the provider has updated an account.
shortcut_heuristics: Challenge execution-alone, any-acceptance, all-or-none, nearest-signature and provider-contact rules. A connective can predict the delta but cannot by itself justify the named trustee edge.
Check filenames, headings, copied notices, acknowledgement text and receipt order for an unintended roster or alternative proof. Use reordering only in review.
success_criteria: The sole literal edit preserves a coherent actual handover pack in both branches. Independent full-file keys and fresh proof readers agree on the sole delta, the exact positive route and why the other appointments are not supported.

Before authoring, justify each Source by creation, custody and use at this meeting. Stop if a normal definitive handover record bypasses the rule, either mode requires outside law or another changed record, or the moderate inventory depends on padding.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and integration 13–20; blind whole-file and fresh excerpt or mask review 12–18; adjudication and audit 8–13; owner review 3–5. Assumes four isolated whole-file reads, one chronology pass and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 10 natural Sources. The appointment and receipt history, provider preparation and advice brief serve distinct purposes within one handover. The count is a planning assumption, not an estimate of usual file size.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse A's cut-off and office checks, matched-byte verification, complete-graph comparison and independently rederived same-edge proof diagnostics.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use trustee_of and any independently licensed ordinary relationships. Acceptance, deferral, provider authority and unresolved implementation stay in the companion register.
risks_and_limits: One pair does not estimate a workload effect or establish a general law of joint appointment.
If changing the grouping rule would naturally change the fixed provider or acceptance records, the matched design is not interpretable.

assumptions: The retained fictional terms expressly permit either commencement mode, identify the qualifying acceptance process and require no further act once the applicable acceptance condition is met. The continuing office is unaffected and neither branch creates a vacancy.

Both modes serve credible handover purposes: one allows staged onboarding, the other starts the expanded team together. A pre-change provider enquiry and current holdings review have the same purpose in both branches. Neither requires an already updated mandate.

The recipient records the actual receipt independently of the candidate's signed acceptance; a second candidate's own deferred response is evidence of deferral, not an inference from an empty inbox. No ordinarily received controlling appointment or acceptance record is omitted.
grounding.documentary_situation: An issued appointment instrument names two prospective additional trustees. One eligible acceptance has been received; the other candidate has expressly deferred giving acceptance through the review. The instrument can naturally make the appointments commence separately or together without changing the underlying acceptance records.
grounding.legal_workflow: Review a planned trustee handover alongside preparations to update an investment provider's mandate.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Distinguish completed office changes from pending appointments and administrative preparation.
practitioner_unknowns: Would both commencement modes be expressed in an otherwise identical issued instrument for this handover?
Would signed acceptance, receipt acknowledgement and early provider preparation naturally be retained separately and available together at this review?

references.relevance: Grounds retention of appointment deeds, minutes and investment information, not acceptance requirements or the effect of either commencement rule.

objective.coverage_gap: A changes the disposition of one already signed transfer and deliberately couples retirement with replacement. It cannot diagnose individual versus joint commencement across distinct appointments with the same completed act held fixed. AA counts eligible assents to one decision; AX holds the assent facts fixed and changes which office consequences depend on them.
objective.failure_mechanism: A system may grant office to every named appointee on execution, treat one acceptance as sufficient for all, or withhold both appointments even when commencement is individual. It may give the right roster but cite only the name or a provider contact label.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: With the instruments, candidates, acceptance facts and cut-off otherwise fixed, changing only the grouping rule changes whether the completed acceptance establishes current office for its own signatory. Exact graph recovery and a sufficient attachment in each branch disconfirm the predicted errors on this file.

evidence_dependencies: Two isolated whole-file readers per branch reconstruct the complete exact-name graph. Fresh readers test exact subsets for the operative scope and positive route, and separately for the documented status change and the conditional branch's exclusion.

Test the designation, status sighting and reporting passages alone and in plausible shorter combinations. Separately remove the continuation term, the completed-change fact and its necessary temporal bound, including copies. Independently rederive graphs: loss of evidence of an end is not itself confirmation of continuing marriage or benefit.

Audit apparent live and historical assertions bidirectionally, including the reporting basis, and accept genuinely sufficient subsets without demanding an irrelevant cessation citation in the independent branch.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: Only the named beneficiary edge changes. The strongest positive observation is the operative designation of the exact person under the express independent continuation term. The strongest negative observation is completed cessation of the specified marriage before the cut-off joined to the express dependency. The end of the marriage has independent evidentiary force for spouse_of but is not a necessary citation for the beneficiary edge where its continuation is expressly independent.

A dated adviser sighting retained on the authorised evidence file records the exact parties and completed change from the received final record. Its event date is distinct from the sighting date.

An authorised administrator's downloaded reporting snapshot and separately retained native reconciliation transmittal identify the entries held for reporting and the basis of the old label. Neither is a firsthand account of current marriage or a new beneficiary decision.
The dated review brief records purpose and cut-off without summarising the current roster.
design.intervention: Replace exactly one literal operative continuation span in the issued designation, choosing between a personal designation unaffected by the described marriage and a designation expressly ending if that marriage ends. Keep the named person, historical descriptor and all other bytes and Source order fixed.

negative_controls: A later generation date does not convert the carried-forward label into a new finding or confer current beneficiary status.
Masking the reporting material preserves both keys. The unrelated office survives focal diagnostics.
design.scenario: The same named designation is operative at inception in both branches. After the marriage has ended, its wording either preserves the personal designation or expressly ends the provision. The generated reporting snapshot has its own administrative purpose and does not certify the current status.
shortcut_heuristics: Test current-spouse-only, latest-generated-record, signed-once-means-current and literal-role-word rules. Check titles, filenames, apparent status summaries and copied passages for a verdict or competing current-status route.
success_criteria: Both modes fit the same retained record history, readers distinguish event, sighting, reporting and review dates, and fresh checks verify the sole edge delta and sufficient positive proof.

Stop if the effect of the family-status change must be supplied by external law, the old label was actually independently reconfirmed for the cut-off, or the change would naturally require a second document to differ.

The transmittal explains the basis of the snapshot without independently determining either relationship.

A dated retained sighting affirmatively records that the marriage ended before the review. A later-generated reporting snapshot carries forward an earlier entry for reconciliation; it does not attest to a new family event or decide the provision's effect.

objective.coverage_gap: AC varies the expiry date of a temporary substitution and tests revival of a base provision. AY changes no date, restores no earlier provision, and tests whether a documented change in one relationship has any effect on a different named relationship. AR tests the maker's office at exercise, not whether a descriptor of the designee was made a continuing condition.
objective.failure_mechanism: A system may treat a historical descriptor as a continuing eligibility condition, ignore an express cessation condition because the designation was executed, or promote the later clerical snapshot to evidence that the marriage continues.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: Holding the person, historical marriage, documented change, effective designation and cut-off fixed, varying only whether the provision expressly depends on the marriage continuing changes support for the named beneficiary. The focal current spouse edge remains unsupported in both branches. Correct exact keys and sufficient attachments disconfirm the predicted errors.

proposals.title: A named designation need not depend on continuing marriage

evidence_dependencies: Two isolated complete-file readers reconstruct every exact-name relationship. Fresh readers test the defined phrase and its scope, the ordinary factual passage and the signed current instructions separately, crediting singleton proofs where sufficient.

Remove each factual assertion independently when testing its necessity and remove its copies. Rederive each diagnostic graph and audit apparent kinship language in both directions, including recitals, signing blocks and earlier instructions.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The strongest positive observations are the independent factual description in the instrument and the explicit current parentage statement in signed instructions. The strongest negative observation for the focal proposed parent edge is the express limitation of the inclusion to the particular disposition, not a disproof of parentage. Masking the group provision preserves the factual graph. Removing an otherwise unreplicated factual assertion removes only its dependent support.
genres_and_provenance: The practice's retained executed will extract supplies the scoped group definition and the independently relevant factual identification in another provision.

The client's retained signed original instructions explain the purpose of the special grouping without constituting an additional factual parentage route. A native update request retained as received initiates the later review and identifies the drafting task, not a family conclusion.

The separately retained signed current instructions give the client's firsthand account of actual parentage for the update. A dated adviser brief sets the cut-off and distinguishes existing wording from work still to be drafted.
design.intervention: Score one intact natural condition. Use review-only masks of the entire defined group provision and, separately, the actual firsthand parentage assertion with its copies. Use exact excerpt checks to test the definition's stated scope; do not create an orphaned phrase by stripping its definition and score it as a plausible sibling.
invariants: The supplied inventory, cut-off and exact names are fixed. Independent factual relationships retain their own routes when the group provision is masked.
The will-specific inclusion is not a factual assertion or denial. Intended gifts and unscored estate roles stay outside the graph.
negative_controls: A genuinely factual kinship description in the same published-to-file instrument defeats a blanket ignore-the-will strategy.
Inclusion in the defined group neither licenses a parent edge nor implies a trust beneficiary relationship.
design.scenario: An adviser compares existing testamentary wording with current instructions before drafting an update. Both a genuine kinship description and a family-labelled stipulated inclusion advance real drafting tasks, but only the former asserts a relationship.
shortcut_heuristics: Test family-word matching, blanket exclusion of testamentary text, nearest-name assignment and treating copied instructions as independent witnesses. Inspect filenames, headings and surrounding passages for a leaked verdict or a sufficient route that makes the definition irrelevant to the diagnostic.
success_criteria: Independent readers recover the full graph and distinguish stipulated inclusion from factual identification without outside interpretation of gift validity. Fresh excerpt and mask readers confirm the exact positive routes and the reason for restraint.

Stop if the definition can naturally be read as a factual recital, if the practical instructions independently settle the focal proposed edge, or if either factual observation was added solely as a benchmark control.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring 6–10; blind whole-file and fresh excerpt or mask review 7–11; adjudication and audit 5–8; owner review 2–3. Assumes two isolated whole-file reads and one wording revision at most.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 5 natural Sources. An executed will extract, original and current signed instructions, a native update request and a dated review brief.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse factual singleton checks, full-graph and same-edge scoring, provenance audit and separately rederived review-only mask keys.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use the relevant exact-name kinship predicates, with parent_of directed and symmetric kinship unordered. Do not score group membership, gifts or estate entitlement; record the apparent but unsupported claim in the companion register.
risks_and_limits: A well-drafted express definition may be easy; this checks the scope of a specific assertion, not a general difficulty or prevalence claim.
One natural file cannot estimate an effect of including a definition, changing its location or adding administrative material.

assumptions: The group definition is explicitly limited to the identified provision and includes a named person by stipulation, not by an accompanying factual parentage recital. No inference about biological or legal parentage follows from inclusion.

The executed will has a genuine reason for the separate factual kinship description, such as identifying the recipient of an unrelated specific gift. Signed current instructions independently state actual parentage for a practical drafting reason without making an unnecessary denial or rehearsing the benchmark contrast.
grounding.documentary_situation: The existing will uses an expressly extended family-group label for one distribution provision. It also uses an unqualified factual relationship description elsewhere to identify a person for a separate actual purpose. Current signed updating instructions identify the actual parent of one included person from firsthand knowledge. The instruments and instructions do different work.
grounding.legal_workflow: Review a retained executed will and take signed instructions for a subsequent drafting update.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Preserve the client's deliberate inclusion of named people under a will-specific group term while keeping that term out of the factual family graph.
practitioner_unknowns: Would the instrument and instructions naturally distinguish the special group definition from ordinary factual descriptions, and would these particular records be retained together at the update meeting?

references.relevance: Grounds recorded instructions, reasons for inclusion or exclusion, updates and storage. It does not establish any particular use or legal effect of a defined term.

grounding.retainer: Identify the people and actual family relationships relevant to the instructions without determining gifts or entitlement.

objective.coverage_gap: AB tested closure from two already supported parent edges; here the error precedes composition and concerns what a provision actually asserts. S varies the operative function of a list for a scored trust role. AZ keeps the testamentary definition operative for its own unscored purpose and tests whether a system misreads that purpose as factual kinship.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may read an instrument-specific inclusion as factual parentage, suppress every fact in testamentary material to avoid that error, or attach the definition as proof of a relationship actually stated elsewhere.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The complete file permits exact recovery of stated kinship without a focal parent edge sourced merely from a will-specific grouping. Correct recovery, restraint and sufficient attachment disconfirm the predicted errors on this file.

proposals.title: A will's defined group is not a family assertion

stopping_criteria: Do not advance a reserve unless each Source has a plausible creator, dated business purpose, custody and availability by the stated cut-off. Prefer a shorter honest file or defer if the nominated tier cannot be justified. Do not suppress a normally available controlling document.

Require isolated complete-file graph reconstructions, independently checked exact sufficient subsets, and separately rederived necessary-component diagnostics. Credit genuine alternatives and singletons; do not force redundant citation. Stop if a shortcut supplies an equally sufficient route that eliminates the claimed mechanism or if independent readers cannot resolve a key dispute after an allowed revision.

For a matched pair require one verified literal edit, coherent unchanged records, and the intended exact edge or proof difference. Treat review-only masks and reorders as diagnostics, not scored conditions. Preserve earlier admitted hypotheses, keys and scores.

Require intact full-context delivery and feasible independent review for the moderate inventory. Do not use stitched section keys as whole-file reads or claim placement, workload, prevalence or causal effects not identified by the design.

Keep technical qualification separate from human admission. Do not commission excluded or held-out work, use real client data, expand the protected ontology, seek unseen records or rely on unstated legal defaults.
